No pressure. You are always in control. It is completely free. You do not pay Engines Market anything. Why us Why use Engines Market- 100+ vetted UK suppliers Every specialist has passed our 4-point check (UK registered, trading 1+ year, physical address, 4.0+ star average review). Real price comparison Stop calling around. See multiple quotes side by side. No obligation You are free to ignore every quote. Average saving Based on 24,650 quote requests, most customers save hundreds compared to their first local quote. 4.8 / 5.0 Trustpilot 4.7 / 5.0 Google 4.9 / 5.0 Facebook SSL encrypted No obligation disclaimer Using Engines Market is free and does not commit you to anything. You are not required to accept any quote, contact any supplier, or proceed with any work. Your enquiry is shared only with relevant specialists. You can withdraw your request at any time by contacting us. Full terms are available in our Terms & Conditions . How long does it take to receive quotes- Most users receive 3-5 quotes within a few hours. The average from enquiry to completed engine replacement is 5.2 days (based on our 2025 data). What information do I need- Your vehicle registration number (the API will pull make, model, and engine details) plus a brief description of the problem - e.g., “rattling noise on cold start”, “blue smoke”, “engine won’t start”. Will you share my personal details- Only with relevant suppliers - and only to enable them to quote. We do not sell your data. See our Privacy Policy for full details. What if my car is very old or rare- Our network covers a wide range of vehicles. Even for older or less common models, we will share your enquiry with specialists who are most likely to help. mainEntity.name: How to get a free engine replacement quote
mainEntity.description: Get a free engine replacement quote in 4 simple steps. No hidden fees, no obligation.

step.name: Submit your registration and details
step.description: Enter your vehicle registration number. Our system automatically identifies your make, model, and engine using DVLA data. Add a brief description of the problem (e.g., timing chain rattle, smoke).

step.name: We match you with relevant suppliers
step.description: Your anonymised enquiry is shared only with specialists from our network of 100+ vetted UK suppliers who can genuinely help with your engine type and location.

step.name: Receive 3-5 quotes
step.description: Suppliers send you quotes directly via email or phone-typically within a few hours. Compare prices, warranty terms, and services side by side.

step.name: Choose a supplier - or walk away
step.description: There is absolutely no obligation. You decide whether to contact a supplier, accept a quote, or walk away for free.

acceptedAnswer.text: You need your vehicle registration number (our API pulls the make, model, and engine details) plus a brief description of the problem-e.g., rattling noise on cold start, blue smoke, or engine won't start.
